question: In Table 1, which company is running the NBF-006 trial, and what is its status?

trace.query: SELECT c.id, c.row_no, c.col_no, c.text FROM cells c WHERE c.table_id='p2.T1' AND c.row_no IN (SELECT row_no FROM cells WHERE table_id='p2.T1' AND text ILIKE '%NBF-006%') ORDER BY c.row_no, c.col_no
SELECT id, row_no, col_no, text FROM cells WHERE table_id='p2.T1' AND row_no BETWEEN 10 AND 14 ORDER BY row_no, col_no
SELECT id, row_no, col_no, text, top, bottom FROM cells WHERE table_id='p2.T1' AND row_no BETWEEN 9 AND 15 ORDER BY row_no, col_no
SELECT id, text, top, x0 FROM lines WHERE page=2 AND top BETWEEN 455 AND 480 ORDER BY top, x0
SELECT id, text, top, x0 FROM lines WHERE page=2 AND text ILIKE ANY (ARRAY['%Completed%','%Phase 1%','%NBF%','%Nitto%','%Cancer,%']) ORDER BY top, x0
SELECT id, text, top, x0 FROM lines WHERE page=2 AND (text ILIKE '%Completed%' OR text ILIKE '%Phase 1%' OR text ILIKE '%NBF%' OR text ILIKE '%Nitto%' OR text ILIKE '%Colorectal%') ORDER BY top, x0
SELECT id, text, top FROM atoms WHERE page=2 AND (text ILIKE '%Completed%' OR text ILIKE '%NBF-006%' OR text ILIKE '%Nitto%') ORDER BY top
SELECT id, row_no, col_no, text FROM cells WHERE table_id='p2.T1' AND row_no BETWEEN 17 AND 20 ORDER BY row_no, col_no
